verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing control over how long data is kept and no way to delete meetings or transcripts, whether through the UI, the API or MCP tools. The nearby items do not cover this story. "0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners" is Fireflies' own policy toward third parties, not a control users set. Private Storage governs where data is stored, not how long. The optional expiry on shared meetings and the Rules Engine for access and privacy are related but different controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
